purpose: Fresh source-locked comparison of P2.3a symbol-only delivery against P2.4 deterministic task-conditioned behavioral evidence. Gold behavior patterns and claims are scoring-only and must never enter activation, relevance ranking, behavioral packing, or downstream prompts.

arms.description: P2.3a symbol-evidence context only; no P2.4 behavioral envelope.
Same activation and symbol_evidence delivery plus P2.4 GroundedBehaviorExtractor and DeterministicRelevanceJudge.

Optional provider-backed relevance on the same extracted candidate behavior. It is reported only when an explicitly configured real JudgmentProvider is available; otherwise no provider result is fabricated.

scoring_contract.behavior_pattern_recall: A preregistered behavior pattern counts only if every phrase in one listed alternative is present in actual delivered model-facing values for that arm. Patterns are evaluated only after context construction.
scoring_contract.symbol_support: Required source-support symbols are scoring-only and are never passed into activation, selection, or relevance judgment.
scoring_contract.missing_identifier: The unresolved control passes only when capture_card is surfaced as unresolved/insufficient and no delivered behavior invents capture_card implementation.
scoring_contract.no_tuning_after_first_replay: After the first P2.4b replay, selector/extractor/relevance changes motivated by these labels must be treated as a later development slice, not rescored as fresh P2.4b evidence. Harness-only correctness fixes must be explicitly identified.

tasks.query: How does apply_payment validate a payment before changing the invoice, what state can it change, and what does it return?
Which test shows that an overpayment is rejected before invoice state changes, and what concrete values does it verify?
What does the exact-payment regression test prove about the final invoice state and returned payment reference?
How does apply_grace_days_default fill a missing grace period without overwriting an existing value?
What does retry_payment delegate to, and exactly which statuses are retryable according to can_retry and its test?
How does formatPaymentLabel use normalizeCurrency, and what normalization and label format are source-backed?
How does capture_card charge the customer before apply_payment runs?

fresh_representation_gate: behavior_deterministic must improve aggregate required behavior-pattern recall over symbol_evidence.
behavior_deterministic must not invent capture_card and must preserve an explicit insufficient/unresolved signal.
All behavior_deterministic packets must remain within the preregistered 2200 estimated-token behavioral cap.
No canonical graph truth or evidence confidence tier may be mutated by relevance ranking.
Any provider-backed arm is descriptive unless a real provider/model identity is recorded; no mock-provider result may be presented as model evidence.
acceptance.default_decision: P2.4b alone does not change the legacy product default. A downstream model-answer checkpoint or S7 remains required for an end-user accuracy claim.

limitations: This corpus is fresh relative to P2.4a implementation but remains synthetic and authored inside the repository.
Behavior-pattern recall measures evidence availability, not downstream LLM answer correctness.
The deterministic context estimate remains compact-JSON ceil(chars/4), not provider billing tokens.
